title: Land mask for A Winter Sky
source: Derived from the scan above by assets/bake-land.py
note: One channel, half size: white where the painting's copse, far treeline and marsh stand in front of the sky. The line between land and sky was traced by hand on the full scan and refined within 40px of it by the paint itself (the crowns are darker than the cloud bank behind them). The birds are drawn through it; it is never drawn over the painting.
